title: NCAA Ngorongoro Conservation Area Tariff Reference
description: Full NCAA tariff reference: entry permits, crater service fees, vehicle descent, camping, walking safaris, Olduvai Gorge, balloon, horse riding, sundown, filming, bush lunch, boma, penalties, and park rules.

category.description: Fee category e.g. Entry Permit, Crater Service, Vehicle Descent

fee_name.description: Name of the fee or rule

rate_usd.description: Rate in USD (per person unless noted otherwise)

per.description: Unit: per person, per vehicle, per night, per day, etc.

total_usd.description: Total for this line item (unit_rate × quantity)

ncaa_contact.description: Official NCAA contact number or email if this is a contact row

notes.description: Special conditions, rules, or contact info

fee_type.description: Type of fee (entry permit, crater service, vehicle descent, etc.)

rate_description.description: How the rate is calculated (per person, per vehicle, etc.)

tariff_section.description: NCA tariff section reference, e.g. A, B, E

sub_category.description: Sub-type or weight class e.g. adult 16+, child 5-16, ≤2000kg

adult_rate_usd.description: Rate per adult in USD (if applicable)

child_rate_usd.description: Rate per child in USD (if applicable)

unit.description: Per what — person/day, per trip, per landing, per vehicle
